summary: A Yes vote enacts a one-cent sales tax in the City of Santee for ten years to fund city services and infrastructure, including road repairs.

tax.text: A Yes vote would increase Santee’s sales tax by one cent per dollar for 10 years and provide additional revenue for city services and infrastructure.
tax.quote: If approved, the measure would raise Santee’s sales tax rate from 7.75% to 8.75% for the next 10 years.

tax.text: A No vote would keep Santee’s sales tax rate at 7.75% and would not provide the proposed additional revenue.
